sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》出品的《访谈》节目。

sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.
sentences.zh: 我是大卫·马尔凯斯。

sentences.en: Chloe Zhao is an anomaly.
sentences.zh: 赵婷是一个特例。

sentences.en: At only 43, with just five feature films under her belt, she's already established herself as one of cinema's most distinctive and distinguished directors.
sentences.zh: 年仅43岁、仅执导过五部故事片，她就已经确立了自己作为电影界最具独特性和声望的导演之一的地位。

sentences.en: And she's done it at a time when the movie business is increasingly averse to artistic risk and originality, qualities on display in all her work.
sentences.zh: 而且她做到这一点时，电影行业正日益排斥艺术风险与原创性——而这些特质在她所有的作品中都展露无遗。

sentences.en: She started with independent film, including the sparsely poetic neo-Western Nomadland, which won Academy Awards for Best Picture and for Zhao Best Director.
sentences.zh: 她从独立电影起步，包括带有诗意的稀疏风格新西部片《无依之地》，该片为她赢得了奥斯卡最佳影片奖以及赵婷的最佳导演奖。

sentences.en: She then tried her hand at an ambitious mega-budget Marvel movie, Eternals.
sentences.zh: 随后她又尝试了一部雄心勃勃、预算巨大的漫威电影《永恒族》。

sentences.en: And her latest is last fall's heart-wrenching drama Hamnet, an adaptation of Maggie O'Farrill's historical novel about the death of Shakespeare's young son
sentences.zh: 而她的最新力作是去年秋天令人心碎的剧情片《哈姆内特》，改编自玛吉·奥法尔的历史小说，讲述了莎士比亚年幼的儿子

sentences.en: from the plague and the grief his parents experienced after.
sentences.zh: 因瘟疫夭折以及他的父母随之经历的悲痛。

sentences.en: It won two Golden Globes and is up for several Academy Awards, including Best Director.
sentences.zh: 它赢得了两座金球奖，并入围了多项奥斯卡奖，包括最佳导演奖。

sentences.en: So how has she done it?
sentences.zh: 那么她是怎么做到的呢？

sentences.en: Because as I learned firsthand, Zhao is an enigmatic, even somewhat mystical presence in person.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我亲身体会到的那样，赵婷在现实中是一个神秘的、甚至带有某种神秘主义色彩的存在。

sentences.en: Not exactly the sort of hotshot personality we often associate with big-time Hollywood directors.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是那种我们通常与大型好莱坞大导演联系在一起的意气风发的个性。

sentences.en: But as it turns out, Zhao isn't much interested in simple or straightforward answers.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，赵婷对简单或直接的答案并不太感兴趣。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Chloe Zhao.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与赵婷的对话。

sentences.en: Chloe, thank you for taking the time to come speak with us today.
sentences.zh: 赵婷，谢谢你今天抽空来和我们交谈。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: I want to start with an awards season question.
sentences.zh: 我想从一个颁奖季的问题开始。

sentences.en: Your eyes just glazed over a little.
sentences.zh: 你的眼神刚刚有点呆滞了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: No, it's excitement.
sentences.zh: 不，那是兴奋。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was a look of excitement.
sentences.zh: 对，那是一种兴奋的眼神。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like an animal in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 就像丛林里的动物。

sentences.en: Well, there's obviously a lot of awards season buzz around Hamnet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然关于《哈姆内特》有很多颁奖季的热议。

sentences.en: And by the time this interview comes out, we'll know what nominations the film did or didn't get.
sentences.zh: 而且等这期访谈播出时，我们将知道这部电影得到了或没得到哪些提名。

sentences.en: But right now, the thing that I'm curious about is sort of what, like, the whole awards rigmarole stirs up for you.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我好奇的是，整个颁奖季的繁文缛节对你来说激起了什么。

sentences.en: Because I imagine it could involve feelings like of envy or competition or it involves salesmanship or glad-handing,
sentences.zh: 因为我想象这可能包含嫉妒或竞争的感觉，或者包含推销或寒暄，

sentences.en: which I feel like are not necessarily the kinds of feelings or ideas that are interesting to you or come naturally to you.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些不一定是你会感兴趣或对你来说很自然的情绪或想法。

sentences.en: So how do you deal with this moment?
sentences.zh: 所以你是如何应对这个时刻的？

sentences.en: I love that that's almost like a form of compliment that you just did.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你刚刚说的这几乎是一种赞美的方式。

sentences.en: You think of me a lot more highly than...
sentences.zh: 你对我的评价远高于……

sentences.en: Maybe you like doing it.
sentences.zh: 也许你喜欢这样做。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I think that all those quite basic emotions, none of us can escape it, right?
sentences.zh: 但我认为所有这些非常基本的情绪，我们谁也逃避不了，对吧？

sentences.en: And especially artists, so many of us, majority of us started telling stories because we didn't have the easiest childhood.
sentences.zh: 尤其是艺术家，我们当中有这么多人、绝大多数人开始讲故事，是因为我们的童年过得并不是最容易的。

sentences.en: So when your work, right, which is the only way that you can see connection and validation since you're a little child,
sentences.zh: 所以当你的作品——也就是你从小到大唯一能看到联系和认可的方式——

sentences.en: is being compared and judged, you could go as far as feeling a rejection of that is a rejection of who you are and what your ability to belong to a tribe or be safe or be loved.
sentences.zh: 被拿来比较和评判时，你甚至会觉得对它的拒绝就是对你是谁、你是否有能力融入一个群体、是否能感到安全或被爱的拒绝。

sentences.en: You could go that far.
sentences.zh: 你可以走到这一步。

sentences.en: And it does go that far to me at times.
sentences.zh: 对我而言有时确实会走到这一步。

sentences.en: But what I like about it, I don't know if people know, is that filmmaking is quite of a lonely process.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢它的地方——我不知道人们是否知道——是电影制作其实是一个相当孤独的过程。

sentences.en: At least speaking as director, you're like a ronin, you know, you're like a samurai.
sentences.zh: 至少作为导演来说，你就像一个浪人，你知道的，你就像一个武士。

sentences.en: A wandering samurai.
sentences.zh: 一个四处游荡的武士。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're getting hired to do jobs and jobs and jobs.
sentences.zh: 对，你不断被雇佣去做一个又一个的工作。

sentences.en: And then you create this family and then you have to leave again.
sentences.zh: 然后你创造了这个家庭，接着你又不得不离开。

sentences.en: So a worse season,
sentences.zh: 所以颁奖季，

sentences.en: especially if someone like me who came up from independent films and having to go festivals and labs after labs to even get money to grants and to make my first film.
sentences.zh: 特别是对于像我这样从独立电影界走出来、必须去参加一个又一个电影节和实验室、甚至为了筹集资金拿补助来拍第一部电影的人来说，

sentences.en: I was exposed to a lot of my fellow filmmakers over a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 十多年前我就接触过很多同行电影人。

sentences.en: So to be paid, to be brought together and to see each other and to hang out at these, you know, events and roundtables and stuff is actually really nice.
sentences.zh: 因此，能够有薪酬地聚在一起，在这些活动、圆桌会议等场合看到彼此并闲逛，其实真的很好。

sentences.en: I try to ask them to let me come to their set and just shadow people.
sentences.zh: 我试着请他们让我去他们的片场，只是去观摩学习。

sentences.en: I think there should be a system where directors get to be on each other's set.
sentences.zh: 我认为应该建立一个制度，让导演们有机会去彼此的片场。

sentences.en: Otherwise, how do we keep learning?
sentences.zh: 否则，我们怎么继续学习呢？

sentences.en: What do you think someone could learn from watching you work?
sentences.zh: 你觉得别人能从看你工作中学到什么？

sentences.en: How to embrace chaos.
sentences.zh: 如何拥抱混乱。

sentences.en: I mean, pretty much Hamnet was created that way.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，《哈姆内特》基本上就是这样创作出来的。

sentences.en: For example, when Hamnet died, spoiler alert, I don't think you can spoil this one.
sentences.zh: 例如，当哈姆内特死的时候——剧透警告，我觉得这个没法剧透。

sentences.en: It's a historical fact.
sentences.zh: 这是历史事实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Someone died.
sentences.zh: 有人死了。

sentences.en: Someone wrote a play.
sentences.zh: 有人写了一部剧。

sentences.en: Hamnet died.
sentences.zh: 哈姆内特死了。

sentences.en: And on that day, Jesse and I would not talk about, we don't really talk about the scene coming in.
sentences.zh: 而在那天，杰西和我不会谈论——我们进场时其实不会讨论接下来的这场戏。

sentences.en: She would, in the morning, she would do a lot of fever writing about her dreams and then she would pick some music.
sentences.zh: 她会在早晨疯狂地写下她关于梦境的文字，然后她会挑选一些音乐。

sentences.en: And so as soon as I get to set up, I will just put the music on repeat.
sentences.zh: 所以当我一到片场，我就会把音乐单曲循环播放。

sentences.en: So the whole set sort of get harmonized to the vibration she wants to be vibrating in.
sentences.zh: 这样整个片场就会逐渐与她想要共振的频率产生共鸣。

sentences.en: And other than a conversation about which setup we want to do, we just go in there and do it.
sentences.zh: 除了讨论我们要拍哪个机位之外，我们直接就进去开拍了。

sentences.en: And so when she let out that very guttural scream of grief, that was not something that was planned from me, nor her.
sentences.zh: 所以当她发出那声极具悲伤内脏感的尖叫时，那并不是我和她计划好的。

sentences.en: But I do believe it didn't just come from her.
sentences.zh: 但我相信那不仅仅来自于她。

sentences.en: It came from the collective, the village.
sentences.zh: 它来自于集体，来自于那个村庄。

sentences.en: And when that happens, I can feel it.
sentences.zh: 当那种情况发生时，我能感觉得到。

sentences.en: And it's the most exciting thing for me as a director because I go, there's no way any of us could have thought of that.
sentences.zh: 对我作为导演来说，这是最令人兴奋的事情，因为我想，我们当中任何人都绝对想不出这一出。

sentences.en: And because that is truth happening in the moment.
sentences.zh: 因为那是当下发生的真实。

sentences.en: And I will bottle that up and I will define it in the edit and I will make sure it goes into the world.
sentences.zh: 我会把这个收集起来，在剪辑中确立它，并确保它呈献给世界。

sentences.en: You know, it's so interesting to hear you talk about the practicalities of directing for you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，听你谈论导演对你而言的实用性，真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: Because, you know, often when I've heard other directors talk or read about other directors, there's recurring images or tropes of how a director behaves that are, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，通常当我听到其他导演谈论或读到关于其他导演的报道时，会有一些关于导演如何表现的重复影像或刻板印象，你知道的，

sentences.en: it's like, I want to say it's Francis Ford Coppola who said this.
sentences.zh: 就像，我想说是弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉说过这个。

sentences.en: I could be wrong, but he compared being a director to like being a ringmaster of a circus that's inventing itself every day.
sentences.zh: 我可能记错了，但他把当导演比作马戏团的领班，而这个马戏团每天都在自我发明中。

sentences.en: Or sometimes you hear directors compared with generals or something like that.
sentences.zh: 或者有时你会听到导演被比作将军之类的人。

sentences.en: And these are all sort of very, to my mind, kind of like alpha, aggressive, macho metaphors for the job of directing on the day.
sentences.zh: 在我的脑海里，这些都是非常具有主导性、攻击性、大男子主义的隐喻，用来形容日常的导演工作。

sentences.en: That's great, too.
sentences.zh: 那也很棒。

sentences.en: But it's so not what you're describing.
sentences.zh: 但这完全不是你所描述的那样。

sentences.en: And I just wonder if you could talk a little bit about how you handle the necessary leadership aspects of being a director and making a movie.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你是否能谈谈，你如何处理作为导演和拍电影所必需的领导力方面。

sentences.en: You know, I like thinking about myth.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我喜欢思考神话。

sentences.en: If you think about, in myth and in archetypes, what are the types that can lead traditionally?
sentences.zh: 如果你思考神话和原型中，传统上哪些类型能够发挥领导作用？

sentences.en: Yes, you have a general, but you also have a priestess.
sentences.zh: 是的，你有将军，但你也有女祭司。

sentences.en: Both can evoke the desire for people to get excited to follow their vision.
sentences.zh: 两者都能唤起人们渴望兴奋并追随其愿景的欲望。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that the example you give of what Francis, you know, said that he is that and I'm this.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着你举的弗朗西斯说过的话的例子就代表他是那样而我是这样。

sentences.en: Both of these two archetypes is within ourselves.
sentences.zh: 这两种原型其实都存在于我们自身内部。

sentences.en: So there is a general inside of me, but there's also a priestess inside of me.
sentences.zh: 所以我的内心既有一个将军，也有一个女祭司。

sentences.en: It just depends on the scene.
sentences.zh: 这只取决于那场戏。

sentences.en: It depends on the film.
sentences.zh: 取决于那部电影。

sentences.en: And some filmmakers have a bit more priestess energy in them than generals, but both can lead.
sentences.zh: 有些电影人身上的女祭司能量比将军多一些，但两者都能领导。

sentences.en: And both are needed.
sentences.zh: 并且两者都是需要的。

sentences.en: If you only have the priestess, it's total chaos.
sentences.zh: 如果你只有女祭司，那就是完全的混乱。

sentences.en: Black hole.
sentences.zh: 黑洞。

sentences.en: If you only have the general, it's total order and just one beam of light and nothing else.
sentences.zh: 如果你只有将军，那就是完全的秩序，只有一束光，别的什么都没有。

sentences.en: But I like to be in those two extreme polarities.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢处于这两种极端对立之间。

sentences.en: I suppose to constantly kind of have my hands in everything, controlling everything, but also not fully controlling everything.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢总是把手伸进每件事里、控制一切，但也不喜欢完全不控制一切。

sentences.en: No, I like to be total surrender and then total control.
sentences.zh: 不，我喜欢先完全臣服，然后完全控制。

sentences.en: Well, I have kind of a historically inclined question for you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我有一个带点历史倾向的问题想问你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So in Shakespeare's time, the time period in which Hamnet is set, the death of a child was a much more common occurrence than it is now, at least in rich Western countries.
sentences.zh: 所以在莎士比亚的时代——也就是《哈姆内特》背景所在的时期，失去孩子比现在要常见得多，至少在富裕的西方国家是这样。

sentences.en: And I assume that as a result of that, people just had a different perspective on what it meant to lose a child or different feelings or expectations.
sentences.zh: 我猜正因为如此，人们对失去孩子意味着什么有着不同的视角，或者有不同的感受和期望。

sentences.en: And I'm just curious how you thought about that with your film and if you think it's possible to recreate older emotional perspectives.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你是如何在你的电影中思考这一点的，以及你认为重塑古代的情感视角是否可能。

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: I think about that all the time.
sentences.zh: 我无时无刻不在思考这个问题。

sentences.en: Maggie said that she doesn't believe it's possible that the grief is any less.
sentences.zh: 玛吉说她不相信悲伤会减少哪怕一点点。

sentences.en: Maggie O'Farrell, the author.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·奥法尔，这位作家。

sentences.en: The author, yeah.
sentences.zh: 这位作家，对。

sentences.en: She said that to me from the start.
sentences.zh: 她从一开始就对我说过这个。

sentences.en: And I tend to agree with her because even though things are so different, our biology hasn't changed and the design that we have to want to protect a child will not change.
sentences.zh: 我也倾向于同意她的看法，因为尽管很多事情大不相同，但我们的生物学属性没有变，我们想要保护孩子的本能设计也不会变。

sentences.en: However, the stories we attach to that pain, which is suffering, might be different because they also have a different relationship with the unseen back then, right?
sentences.zh: 然而，我们附加在那种痛苦——也就是苦难——之上的故事可能会有所不同，因为他们当时与未知世界的关系也不同，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, I recently trained to be a death doula.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我最近接受了临终导乐的培训。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: In the UK.
sentences.zh: 在英国。

sentences.en: I just finished level one training, foundational training.
sentences.zh: 我刚完成第一级培训，也就是基础培训。

sentences.en: And in one of the training sessions, we had to research indigenous cultures from around the world, how they deal with death and dying both today and also in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 在其中一次培训课上，我们需要研究世界各地的土著文化，看他们今天以及过去是如何处理死亡和临终的。

sentences.en: And you can see that the grief of losing a loved one doesn't change, right?
sentences.zh: 你能看到，失去挚爱的悲伤并没有改变，对吧？

sentences.en: However,
sentences.zh: 然而，

sentences.en: the societal understanding of what death is and the space it gives to grief and the ceremonies and how it's embedded in the culture has shifted so much and the medicalization of death,
sentences.zh: 社会对死亡是什么的理解、为悲伤留出的空间、各种仪式以及它如何根植于文化中，都已经发生了巨大的转变，还有死亡的医疗化，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And also in the modern world when death is no longer seen as a natural part of life because now it's about staying alive as long as we can.
sentences.zh: 还有在现代世界中，死亡不再被视为生命自然的一部分，因为现在的一切都是关于尽可能久地活着。

sentences.en: And there's almost some kind of shame around death because it's weak or something or it shouldn't happen.
sentences.zh: 而且死亡周围几乎带有一种羞耻感，因为它代表着软弱或者某种不该发生的事。

sentences.en: So there's so much of that starting being attached to death and dying that actually cause suffering that's not natural to the human condition.
sentences.zh: 因此，有太多这样的观念开始被附加到死亡和临终上，这实际上造成了人类生存状态中本不自然的痛苦。

sentences.en: So I think that's different.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这有所不同。

sentences.en: I want to rip up all my questions and ask you more about wanting to be a death doula.
sentences.zh: 我想撕毁我所有的提问，多问问你关于想成为一名临终导乐的事。

sentences.en: We have another session in the future.
sentences.zh: 我们以后还会有另一场访谈。

sentences.en: Um, why are you interested in becoming a death doula?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你为什么对成为一名临终导乐感兴趣？

sentences.en: Um, because I have been terrified of death my whole life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为我一辈子都对死亡感到恐惧。

sentences.en: I still am so afraid.
sentences.zh: 我到现在还是很害怕。

sentences.en: And because I've been so afraid, I haven't been able to live fully.
sentences.zh: 正因为我如此害怕，我一直无法充实地生活。

sentences.en: I haven't been able to love with my heart open because I'm so scared of losing love, which is a form of death.
sentences.zh: 我无法敞开胸怀去爱，因为我太害怕失去爱了，而失去爱就是死亡的一种形式。

sentences.en: So when you're in your 40s, which is great, by the way, midlife crisis is the best thing that can happen to you.
sentences.zh: 所以当你到了四十多岁时——顺便说一句，这很棒，中年危机是你身上能发生的最好的事。

sentences.en: Because what it does is you're on your way to a rebirth.
sentences.zh: 因为它能做到的就是让你走上重生的道路。

sentences.en: You can't run from this feeling.
sentences.zh: 你无法逃避这种感觉。

sentences.en: Your body is changing and you can feel death.
sentences.zh: 你的身体正在发生变化，而且你能感受到死亡的存在。

sentences.en: And I, because I'm so scared of it, I have no choice but to start to develop a healthier relationship with it.
sentences.zh: 而我，因为对此感到无比恐惧，别无选择，只能开始与它建立一种更健康的联系。

sentences.en: Or I'm not going to make, I'm not going to make it.
sentences.zh: 否则我就撑不下去了，我真的撑不下去了。

sentences.en: The second half of life would be too hard.
sentences.zh: 人生的下半场会变得太艰难。

sentences.en: So it's a way of facing your fear.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种直面恐惧的方式。

sentences.en: It's a way of understanding.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种理解的方式。

sentences.en: Because making Hamnet helped me understand that I just know there is another way.
sentences.zh: 因为制作《哈姆内特》帮助我明白，我只是知道还有另一条路可走。

sentences.en: I just have a feeling that whoever designed this have decided that you will be born and then die.
sentences.zh: 我只是有一种感觉，无论设计这一切的是谁，他们都决定了人必须生，然后必须死。

sentences.en: You will love deeply but then lose love.
sentences.zh: 你会深爱，但随后又会失去爱。

sentences.en: It's almost like a cosmic joke.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像是一个宇宙开的玩笑。

sentences.en: We're the only one in nature that have a problem with that process.
sentences.zh: 我们是自然界中唯一对这个过程有意见的物种。

sentences.en: We must be designed to know how to die.
sentences.zh: 我们生来就注定要懂得如何死亡。

sentences.en: It shouldn't be this terrifying that I can't even live.
sentences.zh: 这不该恐怖到让我甚至无法生活。

sentences.en: That must be not the intention.
sentences.zh: 那一定不是设计的初衷。

sentences.en: Oh, it's not this terrifying to everyone.
sentences.zh: 哦，对每个人来说，这并没有这么可怕。

sentences.en: I hope not.
sentences.zh: 但愿如此。

sentences.en: But I just, I do know that a lot of the issues we have in the world comes from ultimately that deep fear of death.
sentences.zh: 但我只是，我确实知道，我们在世界上遇到的很多问题，归根结底都源于对死亡的深深恐惧。

sentences.en: Are you afraid of your own non-existence?
sentences.zh: 你害怕自己不复存在吗？

sentences.en: Are you afraid of the pain of death?
sentences.zh: 你害怕死亡的痛苦吗？

sentences.en: I think it's impermanence.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是无常。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, the impermanence.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种无常。

sentences.en: So in Hamlet, right?
sentences.zh: 所以在《哈姆雷特》里，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: There's a line that goes, all living things must die.
sentences.zh: 有这样一句台词，所有活着的生命都终将一死。

sentences.en: Passing through nature to eternity.
sentences.zh: 从自然走向永恒。

sentences.en: If in your life, eternity doesn't exist, right?
sentences.zh: 如果在你的生活中，永恒并不存在，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you didn't grow up with spirituality or religion.
sentences.zh: 因为你成长过程中没有接触过灵性或宗教。

sentences.en: So the eternity part is out.
sentences.zh: 所以永恒的部分就被排除了。

sentences.en: You also lost your connection with nature, even your own body, your own body wisdom.
sentences.zh: 你同时也失去了与自然的联系，甚至失去了与你自己的身体、你自己的身体智慧的联系。

sentences.en: Then passing through nature part of that sentence is gone.
sentences.zh: 那么那句话里“穿过自然”的部分也就消失了。

sentences.en: All you have left is all living things must die.
sentences.zh: 你剩下的只有所有活着的生命都终将一死。

sentences.en: That's no fun, you know?
sentences.zh: 这可一点也不好玩，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And that's like, wait, well, then what's the point, you know?
sentences.zh: 这就好像是，等等，那还有什么意义呢，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So you sort of separate it from the oneness.
sentences.zh: 所以你有点把自己从这种合一中分离出去了。

sentences.en: But for me, I feel separated often from that oneness.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，我常常觉得自己与那种合一相隔阂。

sentences.en: And that illusion of separation makes me afraid to connect, makes me afraid to create freely or even just live in the way I want to live.
sentences.zh: 而这种分离的幻觉让我害怕去连接，害怕去自由创造，甚至害怕按照自己想要的方式生活。

sentences.en: You alluded to a midlife crisis.
sentences.zh: 你刚才暗示了中年危机。

sentences.en: Is that something you're currently experiencing?
sentences.zh: 这是你目前正在经历的吗？

sentences.en: I'm kind of at the, so if it's four seasons, I'm at the end of winter, beginning of spring.
sentences.zh: 我大概处于，如果按四季来算的话，我处于冬末春初。

sentences.en: I'm coming back up.
sentences.zh: 我正在重新走出来。

sentences.en: So actually, a better metaphor, I like metaphor, speaking of metaphor, because it makes more sense to me.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，有个更好的比喻——我喜欢比喻，说到比喻，因为这对我来说更有意义。

sentences.en: In the chrysalis period, I've passed the deepest part of the decomposing from the caterpillar, let's put it that way,
sentences.zh: 在蛹化期，我已经度过了毛毛虫开始分解的最深阶段，我们这么说吧，

sentences.en: which was extremely uncomfortable for a year and a half of just sitting there, having every part of who you used to be grinded down.
sentences.zh: 那极其难熬，花了一年半的时间就坐在那里，让你曾经的每一个部分都被碾碎。

sentences.en: Can you tell me, what did that look like for you?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我，对你来说那是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: It looks like getting out of bed is hard, you know, being interested in anything, just getting through the day, because everything that I used to use to distract myself,
sentences.zh: 那表现为起床都很困难，你知道的，对任何事都提不起兴趣，只是勉强度过每一天，因为我以前用来分散注意力的一切，

sentences.en: or everything that I thought is what I wanted in life, and everything will be fine if I get them, or everything that I thought is who I was, no longer is.
sentences.zh: 或者我以为那是生活中我想要的一切，只要得到它们一切都会好起来的一切，或者我以为那是“我”的一切，都不复存在了。

sentences.en: So I'm sort of at the end of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我差不多快走到那阶段的尽头了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And Hamnet, by the way, was what saved me in many ways, to have that film during that time.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，《哈姆内特》在很多方面拯救了我，在那段时间里能有这样一部电影陪伴。

sentences.en: And you said you struggled to connect with people, struggled to feel love.
sentences.zh: 你说过你很难与人建立连接，很难感受到爱。

sentences.en: That's very sad.
sentences.zh: 这真的很令人难过。

sentences.en: You have no struggle?
sentences.zh: 你没有什么挣扎吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I have tons of struggles in my life.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我生活中有很多挣扎。

sentences.en: But when you talk about not feeling, or are you talking about having problems with feeling love in relationships with your family?
sentences.zh: 但当你谈到感觉不到爱，或者你是说在与家人的关系中感受爱有问题？

sentences.en: I just want to know more about what you mean about that.
sentences.zh: 我只是想更多地了解你这话是什么意思。

sentences.en: If you're terrified of being abandoned, right, cast out a tribe, then you don't make an effort to belong, or truly love from a place of vulnerability and trust, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你害怕被抛弃，对吧，被逐出部落，那么你就不会去努力融入，或者从脆弱和信任的角度去真正地爱，对吧？

sentences.en: And that's really sad, because we, I don't think we're designed to be alone, to do it alone.
sentences.zh: 这真的很可悲，因为我们，我不认为我们生来就是孤单的，不是为了独自面对这一切的。

sentences.en: We're designed as like wolves, you know, like pack people.
sentences.zh: 我们就像狼一样，你知道的，是群居动物。

sentences.en: But to be cast out of your tribe, it's the most painful thing you can experience.
sentences.zh: 但被逐出你的部落，这是你能经历的最痛苦的事情。

sentences.en: Or to be abandoned by people that, you know, that you love, and that love you, doesn't even mean intentionally.
sentences.zh: 或者被你所爱并且也爱你的人抛弃，甚至不一定是指故意为之。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, someday could die.
sentences.zh: 你知道，总有一天会死去。

sentences.en: Can I take a stab at something?
sentences.zh: 我可以试着猜一下吗？

sentences.en: You tell me.
sentences.zh: 你来告诉我。

sentences.en: Yeah, I can discern.
sentences.zh: 是的，我能看出来。

sentences.en: And all my publicists can come in and throw a bottle at you, one or the other.
sentences.zh: 所有我的公关可能会进来向你扔瓶子，两者必居其一。

sentences.en: You know, when you talk about being cast out of your tribe, or...
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你谈到被逐出部落，或者……

sentences.en: I'm discerning.
sentences.zh: 我正在观察。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你什么意思？

sentences.en: I know what you're going to say.
sentences.zh: 我知道你要说什么。

sentences.en: I'm going to ask about family stuff.
sentences.zh: 我要问关于家庭的事情。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You grew up in China, and then moved to the United States when you were 14?
sentences.zh: 你在中国长大，然后14岁时搬到了美国？

sentences.en: No, actually, I moved to the UK.
sentences.zh: 不，实际上，我搬到了英国。

sentences.en: UK firSt.
sentences.zh: 先去了英国。

sentences.en: UK first, and then, yes.
sentences.zh: 先去英国，然后，是的。

sentences.en: Was there some sort of familial separation there that's related to the casting out you're talking about?
sentences.zh: 那里面是不是有什么家庭分离，和你说的那种被驱逐有关？

sentences.en: I can't really go into it, but I will answer it the best I can, is that it is an investigation I have been doing the last four years of where does that come from, you know?
sentences.zh: 我无法深入探讨，但我会尽我所能回答，那就是我过去四年一直在调查这种感觉究竟从何而来，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I think it's a lot older than, I feel like, even in this life.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得它比我想象的还要久远，甚至感觉超越了今生。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我真的这么觉得。

sentences.en: You know, you started by asking me about a worse season, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你一开始问我关于最糟的季节，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It feels like a long time ago now.
sentences.zh: 现在感觉那已经是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: But it's relevant because what is this fear of failing?
sentences.zh: 但这很相关，因为这种对失败的恐惧到底是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What is this fear when my film, you know, gets rejected by the critics?
sentences.zh: 当我的电影遭到影评人拒绝时，这种恐惧究竟是什么？

sentences.en: What is this feeling if the box office is terrible?
sentences.zh: 如果票房惨淡，这种感觉又是什么？

sentences.en: You know, what if I lose everything?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我失去一切会怎么样？

sentences.en: You know what, I look around at an awards show, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我在颁奖典礼上环顾四周，对吧？

sentences.en: And I look at the tables, and then when the winner is announced, and I look at the faces of the people who didn't win.
sentences.zh: 我看着那些桌子，当宣布获奖者时，我看着那些没有获奖的人的脸。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And I try to feel like, what are they feeling?
sentences.zh: 我试着去感受，他们在感受什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And at best, it's like, that person must have had an easier childhood.
sentences.zh: 往最好里想，就像是，那个人一定有个更轻松的童年。

sentences.en: At worst, it's like, I don't belong.
sentences.zh: 往最坏里想，就像是，我不属于这里。

sentences.en: They reject me.
sentences.zh: 他们排斥我。

sentences.en: I might as well just die.
sentences.zh: 我索性死了算了。

sentences.en: Do you think people sitting around the tables at award shows are having that feeling?
sentences.zh: 你觉得坐在颁奖典礼桌旁的人会有这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: I think there's a few, probably.
sentences.zh: 我想大概有一些人会有吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And probably more than that.
sentences.zh: 而且可能不止几个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Because then, you know, what if work is your sense of belonging?
sentences.zh: 因为你知道的，如果工作就是你的归属感呢？

sentences.en: You know, what if you feel like you don't belong anywhere but with your family?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你觉得除了家人身边，你哪里都不属于呢？

sentences.en: Then what if your family is gone?
sentences.zh: 那如果你的家人不在了呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It makes me realize any kind of belonging has a risk of being cast out.
sentences.zh: 这让我意识到，任何形式的归属感都伴随着被驱逐的风险。

sentences.en: And then you have to ask this, you know, people might roll their eyes when I say this, but that kind of home, the one that cannot be taken away,
sentences.zh: 然后你不得不问这个问题，当我说这个时人们可能会翻白眼，但那种家，那种无法被夺走的家，

sentences.en: it's the one within, and it's the one that you connect with the divine, with this great mystery that you have different culture, a different word for it.
sentences.zh: 是内心的家，是与神圣、与那种伟大的奥秘相连的家，不同文化对它有不同的称呼。

sentences.en: And if you do an ayahuasca ceremony or plant medicine, you feel that, that oneness.
sentences.zh: 如果你做过死藤水仪式或植物药物疗愈，你就会感受到那种合一。

sentences.en: And you have no fear in those moments, right?
sentences.zh: 在那些时刻你没有任何恐惧，对吧？

sentences.en: That's why, you know, warriors would take medicine before they go into it.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，你知道，勇士在冲锋陷阵之前会服用药物。

sentences.en: Have you done ayahuasca ceremonies?
sentences.zh: 你做过死藤水仪式吗？

sentences.en: No comment.
sentences.zh: 无可奉告。

sentences.en: No, I have not done a ayahuasca ceremony.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有做过死藤水仪式。

sentences.en: I have experienced, facilitated plant medicine healing journeys by my therapist, right?
sentences.zh: 我体验过由我的治疗师协助的植物医学疗愈之旅，对吧？

sentences.en: And I've experienced that kind of oneness that when all the stuff goes away, you really do feel like you're one with everything and truly no fear, you know?
sentences.zh: 我体验过那种合一，当所有杂念都消失时，你真的会觉得自己与万物合一，而且确实毫无恐惧，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And so, to answer your question about did it happen when I left China to go to school, you know, or did it happen when a film of mine didn't work out, did it happen when...
sentences.zh: 所以，回答你关于这是否发生在我离开中国去上学时，你知道的，或者是否发生在我的一部电影失败时，是否发生在……

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm trying to locate the source of the feeling you're talking about, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，我正在试图找出你所说的那种感觉的源头，是的。

sentences.en: That is, I tried that for many, many years because we have to understand why, right?
sentences.zh: 我为了这个尝试了很多很多年，因为我们必须明白为什么，对吧？

sentences.en: We must know because that's how we feel safe.
sentences.zh: 我们必须知道，因为那是我们感到安全的方式。

sentences.en: We must understand why this thing happened.
sentences.zh: 我们必须明白为什么会发生这种事。

sentences.en: But I sort of got to a point where I realized that even the need to understand where it came from is a form of control and it's a form of fear.
sentences.zh: 但我差不多到了这样一个地步，我意识到甚至连“想要明白它从何而来”的这种需求，也是一种控制的形式，一种恐惧的形式。

sentences.en: And I let that go a little bit and now it's more about can I sit in that?
sentences.zh: 我稍微放下了这一点，现在更多的是我能不能安坐于这种状态中？

sentences.en: And maybe that is the great paradox of what it means to be human.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是身为人所具有的伟大悖论。

sentences.en: You know, it is to constantly hold that tension of to be or not to be, to love or to be abandoned.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那就是不断承受生存还是毁灭、去爱还是被抛弃的这种张力。

sentences.en: This is a long way for me to avoid your question because I think this could be interpreted very simplistically if I were to try to pinpoint one moment in my life that this made me.
sentences.zh: 为了逃避你的问题我绕了很大一个圈子，因为如果我试图精确指出我生命中让我变成这样的某一个瞬间，这很容易被过度简化。

sentences.en: And I think we try to look at trauma that way.
sentences.zh: 我想我们倾向于那样看待创伤。

sentences.en: It's that.
sentences.zh: 就是那样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Because once you pinpoint it, then you can fix it.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦你精准找到了它，你就能修复它。

sentences.en: But it's not like that.
sentences.zh: 但事情并不是这样的。

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm not giving you all you.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我没有给你一个痛快的回答。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: I was also just thinking he brought up the to be or not to be out of the stupid thought in my head was like, oh, that William Shakespeare really had some good ideas.
sentences.zh: 我刚才也只是在想，他提到了“生存还是毁灭”，我脑子里闪过一个愚蠢的想法，那就是，哦，威廉·莎士比亚真的有很多好主意。

sentences.en: That guy, dude, that guy.
sentences.zh: 那家伙，老兄，那家伙。

sentences.en: I have to say, I really.
sentences.zh: 我得说，我真的。

sentences.en: Underrated.
sentences.zh: 被低估了。

sentences.en: Underrated.

sentences.zh: 我旁边坐着一对老夫妇，我敢肯定他们买票看这部电影是因为他们以为这只是一部布拉德·皮特的电影。

sentences.en: They didn't really understand what they were getting into.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道自己将要看到的是什么。

sentences.en: And they were sort of muttering to each other the whole time.
sentences.zh: 他们一整场都在彼此小声嘟囔。

sentences.en: And then there's one scene in that film where, like, a predator dinosaur puts its foot on the chest of a smaller dinosaur.
sentences.zh: 然后电影里有一幕，比如一只食肉恐龙把爪子踩在了一只较小恐龙的胸膛上。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But then lets the smaller dinosaur go.
sentences.zh: 但接着却放走了那只较小的恐龙。

sentences.en: And you're juSt...
sentences.zh: 而你正……

sentences.en: Because he was already dying.
sentences.zh: 因为它已经快死了。

sentences.en: Already dying.
sentences.zh: 已经快死了。

sentences.en: He knew he was dying.
sentences.zh: 它知道自己快死了。

sentences.en: It's like the dinosaur has, you know, shown an act of mercy.
sentences.zh: 这就像是恐龙展现出了某种仁慈的行为。

sentences.en: It's like a pretty wild, wild film.
sentences.zh: 这真是一部极其狂野的电影。

sentences.en: And the lady beside me just says,
sentences.zh: 我旁边的那位女士直接说了一句：

sentences.en: Morris, what is this movie?
sentences.zh: 莫里斯，这到底是什么电影啊？

sentences.en: And then he got up and walked out of the room.
sentences.zh: 然后他站起身，走出了房间。

sentences.en: Oh, that's such a big moment, that scene for me.
sentences.zh: 哦，对我来说，那个场景真的是个重大的时刻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because he is suggesting that grace is the natural state of the universe.
sentences.zh: 因为他在暗示，恩典是宇宙的自然状态。

sentences.en: And that's what Terry believes in.
sentences.zh: 这也是泰瑞所相信的。

sentences.en: I've seen that film, I don't know how many times.
sentences.zh: 那部电影我看过，我都数不清看过多少次了。

sentences.en: As many times I've seen Happy Together.
sentences.zh: 就像我看《春光乍泄》一样多次。

sentences.en: Yeah, I have never met him.
sentences.zh: 对，我从来没见过他。

sentences.en: Terrence Malloy.
sentences.zh: 特伦斯·马洛伊。

sentences.en: Never spoken to him.
sentences.zh: 从没和他说过话。

sentences.en: But on January 1st this year, I got a phone call from a unknown number.
sentences.zh: 但今年1月1日，我接到了一个陌生号码打来的电话。

sentences.en: Well, a number I don't recognize.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是一个我不认识的号码。

sentences.en: I thought it was the dog workers I was interviewing.
sentences.zh: 我以为是我正在采访的那些救助流浪狗的人。

sentences.en: I said, hello.
sentences.zh: 我说，你好。

sentences.en: And then I hear this very soft voice and goes,
sentences.zh: 然后我听到一个非常轻柔的声音说：

sentences.en: Oh, hello.
sentences.zh: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: This is Terrence.
sentences.zh: 我是特伦斯。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I was thinking, Terrence, which Terrence?
sentences.zh: 我当时在想，特伦斯，哪个特伦斯？

sentences.en: For the first 30 seconds, I was still wondering if it was actually him as he's talking about Hamnet.
sentences.zh: 在前30秒里，当他一直在聊《哈姆内特》时，我还在纳闷这到底是不是他本人。

sentences.en: Oh, what did he say to you?
sentences.zh: 哦，他对你说了什么？

sentences.en: I can't share that, but.
sentences.zh: 这个我不能分享，但是……

sentences.en: Give me the giSt.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说大意吧。

sentences.en: Because Terrence Malick, you know, famously, he doesn't give interviews.
sentences.zh: 因为众所周知，特伦斯·马利克从不接受采访。

sentences.en: He's, I mean, as far as the media is concerned, he's reclusive.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就媒体而言，他是个隐士。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was surreal.
sentences.zh: 对，这太超现实了。

sentences.en: But I won't share what he said, but I can share with you.
sentences.zh: 但我不会分享他说了什么，不过我可以跟你分享……

sentences.en: This is something that, go back to the sitting right line.
sentences.zh: 这有点像，回到刚才那句“正襟危坐”的话。

sentences.en: I said to him that I feel that I come from a lineage that is fond, not necessarily, like, I'm still trying to get back to the lineage of storytellers from my own culture,
sentences.zh: 我跟他说过，我觉得我来自一个充满热爱的传承，倒不一定说——我其实还在努力寻回自己文化中的故事讲述者传承，

sentences.en: from the Chinese culture.
sentences.zh: 也就是中华文化的传承。

sentences.en: I'm slowly working my way there, but I didn't have access to that, just life circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我正在慢慢朝着那个方向努力，但由于生活的种种境遇，我以前接触不到这些。

sentences.en: You know, I came to the West, and I was, even as a storyteller, wasn't sure what's my lineage.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我来到西方，而且，作为一个讲故事的人，我甚至不确定我的传承是什么。

sentences.en: And so his films allowed me to become a part of a lineage.
sentences.zh: 所以他的电影让我得以成为某种传承的一部分。

sentences.en: I feel that I come from his lineage.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我继承了他的衣钵。

sentences.en: You know, even though he never told me as a student, or I didn't give him a choice, I told him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽管他从未以学生的身份教导过我，或者说我没给他选择的机会，我直接告诉了他。

sentences.en: But I did, it is very significant as a storyteller, because you feel like you belong somewhere.
sentences.zh: 但我真的觉得，作为一个讲故事的人，这意义重大，因为你会觉得自己有所归属。

sentences.en: It's also nicer to say I come from his lineage, rather than I rip him off with all those shots of wind gently blowing through the natural landscape.
sentences.zh: 而且说我继承了他的衣钵，总比说我抄袭了他那些微风轻轻吹过自然风景的镜头要好听一点。

sentences.en: That's really funny you said that.
sentences.zh: 你这么说真的太逗了。

sentences.en: I said, there's a fine line between what I just said, and I pretty much copied a lot of yours.
sentences.zh: 我说，我刚才说的话和“我几乎抄袭了你很多东西”之间，其实只有一线之隔。

sentences.en: He says, oh, no, no, that's not.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，不，不，不是这样的。

sentences.en: I have no shame around that.
sentences.zh: 我对这倒没什么好羞耻的。

sentences.en: But in Eternals, the sequence of the creation of the universe was very humbly inspired by the sequence from Tree of Life.
sentences.zh: 但在《永恒族》中，宇宙诞生的那个片段，其实非常虚心地灵感取自《生命之树》中的片段。

sentences.en: You will see exact shots.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一模一样的镜头。

sentences.en: There's something I want you to try and help me understand a little bit more about you.
sentences.zh: 我有些事想让你试着帮我更深入地了解你一点。

sentences.en: You know, you talk about your desire for connection, but then you also described yourself as someone who has never been able to give love fully.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你谈到你对连接的渴望，但你又把自己描述成一个从来无法全力去爱的人。

sentences.en: And I wonder, is it that you're able to express that side of you through your work, but not so much in life?
sentences.zh: 我在想，是不是因为你能够通过作品表达你那一部分，但在现实生活中却没那么多？

sentences.en: Like, neither your work nor you seems like they're evidence of someone who has a problem with connection.
sentences.zh: 比如，无论从你的作品还是你本人来看，都不像是个对连接有障碍的人。

sentences.en: Oh, you can't judge both by its cover.
sentences.zh: 哦，人不可貌相嘛。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不对。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢。

sentences.en: That's really kind, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，你真的太好了。

sentences.en: But, you know, you make the work that you aspire to be, right?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，你创作出你所向往的作品，对吧？

sentences.en: And if you see in Hamnet, Will couldn't express his grief, but he could write a play about it.
sentences.zh: 正如你在《哈姆内特》中所看到的，威廉无法表达他的悲伤，但他可以写一部关于此的戏剧。

sentences.en: And then create such an intimate environment for people to grieve together.
sentences.zh: 然后为人们创造这样一个亲密的氛围来共同悲伤。

sentences.en: But he himself, maybe hoping through the act of doing that, he himself could grieve.
sentences.zh: 而他自己，也许是希望通过这样做的举动，他自己也能去哀悼。

sentences.en: And to give him that moment at the end of the film is the grace I'm giving to myself.
sentences.zh: 在电影结尾给他这样一个时刻，就是我给予自己的恩典。

sentences.en: Say, hey, you worked pretty hard too.
sentences.zh: 对自己说，嘿，你其实也挺不容易的。

sentences.en: So maybe, hopefully, your work can give it back to you, the vulnerability that's required to love fully, to be loved fully.
sentences.zh: 所以也许，希望你的作品能将这一切回馈给你——去全力去爱、去被全力去爱所需要的脆弱。

sentences.en: Also, I can see in your eyes the desire to figure out, like out of care for me as a human being, to figure out a definition so that we can make things better.
sentences.zh: 另外，我从你的眼中能看到一种渴望，出于对我的关爱，想要找出个定义，好让我们能把事情做得更好。

sentences.en: You know, like it's meaning, I guess what I'm trying to say is, unfortunately, I've learned and I hate that discovery so much.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像是寻找意义，我想说的是，不幸的是，我懂得了这一点，而且我极其讨厌这个发现。

sentences.en: I try to resist it every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在试图抗拒它。

sentences.en: Is that we're just sort of wandering between the two extremes, which is to be able to like really be in the moment and feel, and then to love without fear.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们其实只是在两个极端之间徘徊，一个是能够真正活在当下并去感受，然后毫无恐惧地去爱。

sentences.en: And then total just like annihilation, just wanted to completely disappear into the end of the world where no one can find me.
sentences.zh: 而另一个则是彻底的毁灭，只想完全消失在世界的尽头，没有人能找到我。

sentences.en: And I start over and I never have to worry about any of this.
sentences.zh: 然后一切重新开始，再也不用担心这一切。

sentences.en: I find myself just ping-ponging between the two.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己总是在这两者之间像打乒乓球一样反复横跳。

sentences.en: And I used to think something's wrong with that.
sentences.zh: 我过去以为这有什么不对劲。

sentences.en: But at the end of the midlife crisis, I feel like I came to the conclusion at this moment, that's actually the natural state to be in.
sentences.zh: 但在中年危机结束时，我觉得自己在这一刻得出了结论，这其实才是人类应有的自然状态。

sentences.en: We've just never been taught how to ride this wave.
sentences.zh: 只是我们从来没被教过如何去驾驭这股浪潮。

sentences.en: Can I say, you know, I, because I like talking about this kind of stuff, I feel like I have a sense of what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我可以这么说吗，你知道，我，因为我喜欢聊这类话题，我觉得我大概能懂你在说什么。

sentences.en: But I could also very easily imagine somebody listening to what you're saying and thinking, what the hell is she talking about?
sentences.zh: 但我也能非常轻易地想象到，有人听到你的话会想：这丫到底在胡说些什么鬼？

sentences.en: Well, okay, fine.
sentences.zh: 好吧，行吧。

sentences.en: The easier version is that, the easier version to digest is, you know, in nature, everything moves.
sentences.zh: 通俗一点的版本是，比较容易消化的版本是，你知道，在自然界中，万物都在运动。

sentences.en: And that's really scary because we want to hold on to something.
sentences.zh: 而这真的很可怕，因为我们总想抓住点什么。

sentences.en: Listen, I'll give you another fun little adolescence story since that stuff seems to be interesting to people.
sentences.zh: 听着，既然大家似乎对青春期的事很感兴趣，我再讲一个有趣的青春期小故事。

sentences.en: It's that I was so afraid of change and the cycle and movement and being present to them.
sentences.zh: 那就是我曾那么害怕改变、循环、运动，以及去直面它们。

sentences.en: I was so obsessed with Sims, playing Sims, so that I would spend hours and hours and hours and hours playing Sims so that I could control these virtual characters.
sentences.zh: 我曾如此痴迷于《模拟人生》，玩《模拟人生》，以至于我会花上数不清的时间来玩这个游戏，好让我能控制这些虚拟角色。

sentences.en: And even within Sims, I couldn't just let things be.
sentences.zh: 甚至在《模拟人生》里，我也无法让事情顺其自然。

sentences.en: I would tap on it so that they would fall in love and where they would have this job.
sentences.zh: 我会去点他们，让他们相爱，或是给他们安排工作。

sentences.en: I would just control everything with such extreme to regulate myself.
sentences.zh: 我用极端的方式掌控一切，以此来调节自己的情绪。

sentences.en: Gosh, I played Sims for so long, years of my life.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我玩《模拟人生》玩了那么久，花了我好几年的时间。

sentences.en: I'd like to ask a little more about the work that you're doing as a death doula, which you had mentioned before.
sentences.zh: 我想更多地了解一下你作为临终伴护（死亡导乐）的工作，你之前提到过的。

sentences.en: Training.
sentences.zh: 培训。

sentences.en: Training.
sentences.zh: 培训。

sentences.en: Training.
sentences.zh: 培训。

sentences.en: I have now started doing that work.
sentences.zh: 我现在已经开始做那份工作了。

sentences.en: So you're just learning about it.
sentences.zh: 所以你还在了解阶段。

sentences.en: Yeah, I finished, I completed the foundational course.
sentences.zh: 对，我结业了，我完成了基础课程。

sentences.en: And then the next stage would be the diploma.
sentences.zh: 接下来的阶段就是文凭课程了。

sentences.en: And then during that stage, I believe I could practice, but with a mentor.
sentences.zh: 我想在那个阶段期间，我就可以在导师的指导下进行实践了。

sentences.en: Have you ever been with someone at the moment of death?
sentences.zh: 你曾陪伴某人走到过生命的最后一刻吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Have you?
sentences.zh: 你经历过？

sentences.en: I have, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我有，对。

sentences.en: Well, I can't tell you in general of what that is, because from what I learned in training, that every experience is different.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没法概括那种体验具体是什么样的，因为根据我在培训中学到的，每个人的体验都是不同的。

sentences.en: But the biggest thing I learned, both in that experience and also in the training, is that it's a solitary experience.
sentences.zh: 但我从那次经历以及培训中学到的最大一点，就是这是一次孤独的体验。

sentences.en: They say, oh, we all die alone.
sentences.zh: 人们总说，我们都是独自死去。

sentences.en: It is true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Even when you're surrounded by loved ones, it is a very internal, solitary experience, just like birth, as you're going through the birth canal.
sentences.zh: 即使周围环绕着挚爱，这也是一个非常内化的、孤独的体验，就像出生时穿过产道一样。

sentences.en: And when you see that it is a very individual journey, there's a solace to that.
sentences.zh: 当你看到这是一段非常个人的旅程时，你会从中获得一种慰藉。

sentences.en: You know, it made me realize I don't have to accumulate and try to make life decisions so that I won't die alone, because it's so scary to die alone.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我意识到我不需要去刻意积累、去为了不孤独死去而做人生抉择，因为独自死去其实并不可怕。

sentences.en: It's not true.
sentences.zh: 并不是这样的。

sentences.en: I know that for a fact, but I'm not telling that to anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我对此确信无疑，但我不会把这强加给任何人。

sentences.en: You know, everyone has their own journey to get to that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都有自己的路去领悟这一点。

sentences.en: But I do not want to spend my life preparing for my death.
sentences.zh: 但我不想把一生都用来为死亡做准备。

sentences.en: You know, I want to live.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想去生活。

sentences.en: And if that decision led to me being completely on my own in the moment of death, I know that will make a difference for me in those last moments.
sentences.zh: 如果这个决定导致我在临终那一刻完全孤身一人，我知道这对我最后的时刻而言也会有所不同。

sentences.en: And being surrounded by accomplishment, security, loved ones, is still going to be an individual experience, my experience.
sentences.zh: 即便被成就、安全感和挚爱所包围，那终究依然会是一个人的体验，是我自己的体验。

sentences.en: That's also my experience.
sentences.zh: 这也是我的体验。

sentences.en: I was with my mom when she died.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈去世时我陪在她身边。

sentences.en: And my mom, it was interesting because I was there with a couple other close family members there as well.
sentences.zh: 而且很有意思的是，当时我和其他几位至亲也在场。

sentences.en: And my mom wanted us to all be there.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈希望我们大家都在那儿。

sentences.en: And just knowing the type of person who my mom was, I would have thought that she wanted us to all maybe have our arms around her or something like that.
sentences.zh: 以我妈妈的性格，我本以为她会希望我们大家都握着她的手或者做类似的事。

sentences.en: But it was so clear, sorry, it was so clear just in the few moments before it happened that she went somewhere on her own, you know.
sentences.zh: 但就在事情发生前的那几分钟里，很明显——抱歉，真的很明显，她独自去了某个地方，你知道的。

sentences.en: So I also have witnessed the same sort of thing that you witnessed.
sentences.zh: 所以我也见证了和你类似的场景。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: How special it is that you were there to be with her in that moment.
sentences.zh: 你能在那一刻陪伴在她身边，是多么特别的一件事啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: I mean, I certainly don't see life the same way after that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，经历过那之后，我绝对无法再用从前的眼光看待生活了。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You learn some things.
sentences.zh: 你会懂一些道理的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: How do I segue out of that?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么顺着这个话题往下聊呢？

sentences.en: Let me find – oh, accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 让我想想——哦，成就。

sentences.en: That's what I was going to talk about.
sentences.zh: 这正是我要谈的。

sentences.en: That thing.
sentences.zh: 就是那件事。

sentences.en: Earlier when we spoke, and it was mostly in the context of Hollywood Awards and things like that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们刚才聊天的时候，主要是在好莱坞奖项之类的背景下，你知道的，

sentences.en: you touched on things like fear of rejection or wanting validation from peers.
sentences.zh: 你谈到了诸如害怕被拒绝或渴望同行认可之类的情绪。

sentences.en: And it was interesting for me to hear you talk about those feelings because purely from the outside, you're an Oscar-winning director seemingly in the prime of her career.
sentences.zh: 听到你谈论这些感受让我觉得挺有意思的，因为纯粹从外人来看，你是一位正处于职业生涯黄金期的奥斯卡获奖导演。

sentences.en: And even you have those kinds of difficult feelings that arise from your professional life.
sentences.zh: 连你也会在职业生涯中产生这种种纠结的情绪。

sentences.en: And I just wonder, is there any relationship for you between professional success and personal satisfaction?
sentences.zh: 我在想，对你而言，职业成功和个人满足感之间有什么关系吗？

sentences.en: Ideally, ideally, your sense of self-worth is not defined by how many awards you win or how much money your film makes.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下，理想情况下，你的自我价值不该由你赢得多少奖项或电影卖出多少票房来定义。

sentences.en: Ideally.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下。

sentences.en: Or, you know, what would the critics say about your film?
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，影评人会对你的电影作何评价？

sentences.en: Ideally.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下。

sentences.en: Ideally.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下。

sentences.en: But, as we have been talking about the paradox, but I'm trying to learn to be more human, you know, because the reality is you're going to be sort of dancing between the two.
sentences.zh: 但是，正如我们一直在讨论的这种悖论，我正在努力学着变得更接地气、更像个人，你知道的，因为现实情况是你将不得不在两者之间摇摆。

sentences.en: It's like a wave, right?
sentences.zh: 就像海浪一样，对吧？

sentences.en: And then that can happen in one night when you go to a worse show.
sentences.zh: 这种事甚至可能在颁奖典礼的那个夜晚就会发生。

sentences.en: My goodness, it's the ups and downs that are going.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这起起落落真是没完没了。

sentences.en: But imagine if you could go to those things and actually enjoy, like a surfer, every part of the wave.
sentences.zh: 但想象一下，如果你能去参加这些活动并真正享受其中，像个冲浪手一样去享受海浪的每一个部分。

sentences.en: And you actually, like, can you have pleasure in losing and being criticized and failing?
sentences.zh: 你甚至能从失败、被批评和受挫中获得乐趣吗？

sentences.en: I have been investigating that because I refuse.
sentences.zh: 我一直在研究这个，因为我拒绝向其妥协。

sentences.en: Because I know, I know now, at 43 years old, 50% of the time, it's going to be that other side.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道，我现在43岁了，我明白人生有50%的时间会落在另一面。

sentences.en: 50% of the time, it's going to be great.
sentences.zh: 50%的时间会很棒。

sentences.en: The other 50% is going to be shit.
sentences.zh: 另外50%则会是一团糟。

sentences.en: And I want to find pleasure and joy and awe in the shit, too.
sentences.zh: 我也想从那一团糟中找到乐趣、喜悦和敬畏。

sentences.en: So, I'm working on that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我正在为此努力。

sentences.en: How is it going for you, learning to enjoy the shit?
sentences.zh: 你学着去享受那一团糟的过程进展得怎么样了？

sentences.en: I had a lot of shit, you know, in my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的人生经历过不少糟心事。

sentences.en: And so, I don't call it shit.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不叫它狗屎。

sentences.en: I call it, like, the compoSt.
sentences.zh: 我把它叫做，比如说，堆肥。

sentences.en: It's the same thing.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一回事。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's not something you can just say it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这不是随随便便就能说出口的。

sentences.en: You have to learn the tools.
sentences.zh: 你必须学会这些工具。

sentences.en: Plenty of people are trying to figure this shit out.
sentences.zh: 有很多人正试图弄明白这档子事。

sentences.en: Because plenty of people come to terms with, like, okay, half of my life is going to be in the compoSt.
sentences.zh: 因为很多人开始接受这样一个现实：好吧，我人生的一半时间都要在堆肥中度过了。

sentences.en: And I want to learn how to compoSt.
sentences.zh: 而我想学习如何做堆肥。

sentences.en: I don't want to numb myself or buy a new bag or take on a job I don't want, you know.
sentences.zh: 我不想麻痹自己，或者买个新包，或者找一份我根本不想做的工作，你知道的。

sentences.en: Or fall in love with somebody, like, I don't actually love.
sentences.zh: 或者爱上一个我其实并不爱的人。

sentences.en: Just so that I could avoid the feeling of sitting in the compost with a chrysalis.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是为了逃避那种坐在蛹状堆肥里的感觉。

sentences.en: I want to learn how to do it.
sentences.zh: 我想学会怎么做到这一点。

sentences.en: So, I make good life decisions for myself.
sentences.zh: 这样，我才能为自己做出明智的生活抉择。

sentences.en: Chloe, I think I've asked you everything I want to ask.
sentences.zh: 克洛伊，我想我已经问完所有我想问的问题了。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出这么长时间跟我交谈。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.

sentences.en: Thank you for being very graceful and open.
